E1_C-rank_E2_C-comp.stable_ranking_note: population state means AT LEAST ONE canonical member pair shows a multiplicity-adjusted stable difference (max-T family-wise 95%); it is not a claim that the whole ranking is stable

estimand.stable_ranking: pairwise same-condition accuracy difference (canonical member-id direction); SUPPORTED iff some pair is stable in either direction after max-T multiplicity adjustment; permutation invariant by construction
estimand.stable_complementarity: H_stable = E_x max_h q_h(x) - max_h E_x q_h(x); zero iff one member is expectation-best on all tasks; ranking differences do not imply this. Scientific state requires clone-calibrated ccomp_v3.

clone_calibrated.estimand: PRIMARY: D = G_real - G_clone where G is the cross-fitted frozen per-task selector gain vs the best FIXED member. G <= H_stable, G=0 under dominance; the same-code clone subtraction removes the finite-(R,T) selection-noise component. G without a clone arm is reported descriptively only.
